name: cache
description: Buffers incoming records (images + metadata) in a ring and re-emits a buffered record via emit_record on an exchange command — the plugin-side record/replay store. Drives the hot-param re-inspect loop (capture a frame, tune a Param, replay to re-inspect without re-grabbing).

inputs.name: img
inputs.doc: frame to buffer (any key; passed through)
